name: Quartino 2017 Pertuzumab Neoadjuvant PK/Exposure-Response Model
description: Source-complete exact-replay and source-limited dynamic model for Quartino et al. 2017 pertuzumab PK and exposure-response in NeoSphere HER2-positive early breast cancer. The runtime preserves the published two-compartment pertuzumab PopPK structure, the logit pCR exposure-response equation context, NeoSphere arm/covariate/pCR counts, target-attainment values, ANOVA/DDI p-values, and dose-selection thresholds.
